aboutMe.description: I am a Computer Science and Engineering graduate and currently serving as a **Lecturer** in the Department of CSE at **Eastern University**, Dhaka. I am also pursuing an **M.Sc. in Computer Science and Engineering** at **Rajshahi University of Engineering & Technology (RUET)**. My academic and research journey has centered on **Artificial Intelligence**, **Machine Learning**, and **Natural Language Processing**, leading to impactful projects and publications in international conferences. These experiences have strengthened my commitment to continuous learning, effective teaching, and knowledge sharing. I am passionate about fostering innovation in both research and education and aim to contribute meaningfully to the academic and scientific community.
quickPreviews: **Current Position:** Lecturer, Department of CSE, **Eastern University**, Dhaka (June 2026 – Present)
**Graduate Study:** M.Sc. in CSE at **RUET** | **CGPA: 4.00 / 4.00** (1st Semester)
**Research:** 5 conference publications and 1 journal manuscript under review in AI, NLP, computer vision, and multimodal learning
**Recognition:** National Champion in Hackathon 2022 & Top 15 Female STEM talent (Banglalink Womentor 5.0)
